SECOND FIX, and the reason the first attempt regressed: rule 1's search stepped S *= 2, so it only considered powers of two, and a non-pow2 N has no exact stride there -- the loop ran to SAMPLE_S_MAX and rule 1 asked for MORE sampling than rule 0. At M=1 that was +21.5% at N=65532 (4160->16384), +13.2% at N=131068 (8256->16384), +8.1% at N=32832 (4608->8192). Stage 3 fixed exactly this in the repair path and this search was left behind; stepping by SAMPLE_CHUNK_ELEMS zeroes all three and finds wins the doubling form could not reach (N=524288 16384->5440 -5.0%, N=1048572 16384->10816 -4.6%). verify_grid --dist all 2885/2885; inner ACCEPT -0.83% 6 improved 0 regressed; outer ACCEPT -1.71% 130 improved 0 regressed, the largest single move of the v5 run. Fallback pressure fell where the rule changed: under_K>0 lines at M<=32 went 37 -> 6, since a smaller S carries a larger auto_margin.

METHOD FIX, the transferable part: a cell must be fitted on the WORST case over the range it serves, not the argmin at the one N it was measured at. CORRECTNESS FIX (v5 Stage 2). Any row base not a multiple of 4 faulted with HIP 700 on the sampled path while aiter served the same call -- a documented parameter (rowStarts, g_10) behind which topk_avo_supports cannot see, so the dispatcher could not route around it. Root cause is NOT the misalignment: gfx950 serves a 4-byte-aligned global_load_dwordx4 natively (strides 1/3/7/65 give base%4 in {1,3} and pass at prefix=100000 on both the sampled and small_n paths, and declaring vfloat4 aligned(4) changed nothing). It is n4_cover(len) rounding the vector count UP, so the last vector of a slice whose length is not a multiple of 4 reaches 3 floats past it -- into the next row for an interior row, past the ALLOCATION for the last one. Nonzero rowStarts are what put row_start+len within 3 of the pitch. Fixed by load_row_f4<RAGGED> at the six streaming load sites, which loads the final partial vector element-wise under < len. Three forms measured: inline `e+4<=len` +0.39..+0.88% (shipped), hoisted n4_full +0.52..+1.00%, clamp armed only on row==gridDim-1 +0.55..+2.63%. 20 of 34 kernels keep byte-identical instruction streams and every changed one is RAGGED=true, so the scored uniform grid is untouched (inner +0.04%, 0 cells regressed). verify_grid --dist all 2885/2885 with 4 new ROWSTARTS strides (1/3/7/65) as a negative control: all four fault on the pre-fix binary and pass after. Also stride1!=1 added to the aiter dispatch condition so it keeps going to mb/ob instead of hitting the AVO assert. Differential audit now reports no AVO-only failure.
